1a45c5f36fb07ab118db9a10f79ab7413614bb76.sourceText: 因此这是**底盘原点上的虚拟二维扫描**，不是MID360原点上的真实激光束。MID360与底盘有安装偏移，不能把range_min理解成“离雷达外壳0.3 m”。输入是累积地形结果，含不同时间、不同高度的点；同一角度格只留最近的合格点，也不重新验证从底盘虚拟中心到该点是否存在真实光路或遮挡。
1a45c5f36fb07ab118db9a10f79ab7413614bb76.translatedText: Therefore, this is a**virtual 2D scan at the chassis origin**not a real laser beam at the MID360 origin\. The MID360 has a mounting offset from the chassis, so range_min cannot be understood as "0\.3 m from the radar housing\." The input is an accumulated terrain result, containing points at different times and different heights; for the same angular bin, only the nearest qualifying point is retained, and there is no re\-verification of whether a real optical path or occlusion exists from the virtual center of the chassis to that point\.

1adddb1928d4983a631453889ff49498347c2cd2.sourceText: 改成 False 后，代码还会在激光逐点时刻增加协方差预测，通常计算量更大。它不是“把 Point-LIO 输出频率设成 IMU 频率”的开关，也不能保证切换后精度更高。
1adddb1928d4983a631453889ff49498347c2cd2.translatedText: After changing it to False, the code will still add covariance prediction at each laser point time, which usually results in a larger computational load\. It is not a switch for "setting the Point-LIO output frequency to the IMU frequency," nor can it guarantee higher accuracy after switching\.
